Unbiasedness, normal mean unbiasedness, known/unknown-mu variance estimators, bias n-1 over n, Bessel correction, degrees-of-freedom heuristic, and asymptotic-unbiasedness discussion.
Consistency and strong consistency definitions; sample mean and sample kth moments are strongly consistent by the strong law, motivating MoM.
